# i3dnet_network_ip_addresses (Data Source)

Lists the IP addresses in use on one network or on one prefix: the addresses given to your servers and the addresses i3D.net uses itself, such as gateway and router addresses. Set exactly one of `network_id` or `prefix_id`. Free addresses are not listed.

The addresses are read-only: i3D.net allocates them when a server is provisioned and releases them when the server is torn down. Terraform only reads them.

The read fails if the network or prefix does not exist on your account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the addresses of your servers on one network, for example to create DNS A records.
data "i3dnet_network_ip_addresses" "web" {
  network_id = "01928f3e-7c4a-7b1e-9d2f-3a5b6c7d8e9f"
}

output "web_server_ipv4_addresses" {
  value = [for ip in data.i3dnet_network_ip_addresses.web.ip_addresses : ip.address if ip.role == null && ip.family == 4]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the network. Lists the addresses under all of the network's prefixes, IPv4 and IPv6. Cannot be used together with `prefix_id`.
- `prefix_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the prefix. Lists the addresses under this prefix only. Also works for older prefixes that are not part of a network. Cannot be used together with `network_id`.

### Read-Only

- `ip_addresses` (Attributes List) IP addresses in use. An empty list when there are none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_addresses))

<a id="nestedatt--ip_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The IP address, without prefix length, for example `203.0.113.10`.
- `created_at` (String) When the address was allocated (RFC 3339). Null when not known.
- `family` (Number) IP family: `4` for IPv4 or `6` for IPv6.
- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the IP address.
- `prefix_id` (String) ID of the prefix the address belongs to.
- `role` (String) What i3D.net uses the address for, for example `gateway`, `router-ip` or `reserved` (kept free for i3D.net). More values can appear. Null for an address given to one of your servers: filter on `role == null` to get your own addresses.
